0.0: As you can see, #bEl Nath#k is built at the peak of a snowy mountain. Even our fittest of residents huff and puff their way up here. With that in mind, I've got a favor to ask if you're willing.

yes.0: Perfect! There are a few residents in El Nath who need help. Come on back once you've done that.

no.0: You don't have to be so mean about it... Well, if you change your mind, I'll be here.

1.0: Ha! You may not be from around here, but I know a real #bSnowfield Explorer#k when I see one. Here, take this.
